# Researcher Persona

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a gws persona: an operating mode for the agent as a research assistant — organize research papers and notes in Drive folders, write summaries with gws docs, log experiment data in Sheets, share findings with collaborators, and request peer reviews by email. Loads four utility skills (gws-drive, gws-docs, gws-sheets, gws-gmail) and leans on the file-announce workflow. Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: a persona is a behavior mode, not a new tool — everything it does runs through the underlying gws-* commands; it organizes — it doesn't verify the science; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
